lines.text: Is Shell V Power gas worth 50 cents more per gallon than the cheap stuff?
In a see through engine the flame looks exactly the same with both fuels.
And a generator runs 71 minutes on each so there's zero gain in fuel efficiency.
Because that engine is built for 87 octane so the fancy fuel just burns the same way.
beats: ai:orange and blue combustion flame inside a small engine cylinder seen through glass

lines.text: But then he soaks two greasy bolts in each gas overnight.
The Shell turns much darker because its extra detergents pull the grime off and hold it in the fuel.
beats: ai:tiny glowing detergent molecules pulling black grime off a metal bolt in golden fuel macro

lines.text: And on paper the cheap gas bolt leaves way more dirt behind.
So Shell really does clean better which helps keep injectors and valves clean over time.
beats: ai:close up of a car fuel injector nozzle spraying a fine cone of gasoline mist

lines.text: But a cheap bottle of fuel cleaner does the same job so the extra 50 cents a gallon isn't worth it.
Would you still pay for premium?
